The entropy scales as the horizon AREA, not the volume: the holographic principle, the deepest hint that quantum gravity has far fewer degrees of freedom than a local field theory. The M^3 evaporation law makes a primordial black hole of M ~ 1.7e+11 kg evaporate exactly now -- its final gamma-ray burst a cosmological signal (and PBH abundance bound). The Page time (~t_evap/2) is when the radiated information must start re-emerging to preserve unitarity -- the quantitative core of the information paradox, the same physics whose horizon-structure resolutions (echoes, v2.247) the session probed observationally.
